en: The image shows two men dressed in traditional Greek attire, likely the fustanella, which is associated with the historical Greek warriors known as Evzones. Both men have beards and wear embroidered vests, sashes with bullets, and hats. One is standing while the other is sitting, both holding rifles. The background features a neutral, possibly studio backdrop with faint foliage. There is a visible stamp and some handwritten script, as well as printed text.
